He has released numerous hit singles, including Bailamos, Hero, and Escape, not only in Spanish-speaking countries but also on international charts.

name: Joe Rogan
about: Rogan gained initial fame on the 1990s sitcom "NewsRadio", followed by forays into martial arts, where he is a renowned commentator for the UFC.

name: Michael Bublé
about: Michael Bublé, held a life-long dream of becoming a singer - or a hockey player. His voice proved more powerful than his slapshot. With the encouragement of his grandparents (and their record collection) he decided to pursue traditional pop and jazz music.

name: Will Smith
about:
Achieved modest fame as a rapper under the name The Fresh Prince, before starring in the popular television series "The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air".  
 
In the mid-1990s, he moved from television to film, and ultimately starred in numerous blockbuster films including " " and the "Men in Black" series of films.

name: Cameron Diaz
about: Cameron Diaz started out as a model and went on to become one of Hollywood's most recognizable stars through her work in comedic and dramatic films.

name: Chris Martin
about: Chris Martin is best known as the lead vocalist and pianist of the rock band Coldplay.

name: Sarah Jessica Parker
about: Known for her leading role as Carrie Bradshaw on the HBO television series "Sex and the City" (1998–2004). She was also an executive producer on the show, and won two Emmy Awards, for Outstanding Comedy Series in 2001 and Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series in 2004.

name: Naomi Campbell
about: Established herself among the top three most recognizable and in-demand models of the late 1980s and the 1990s, and was one of six models of her generation declared "supermodels" by the fashion world.

name: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
about: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie is a Nigerian author known for her narratives that revolve around the lives of women, with a particular focus on their relationships and societal roles. Her novels explore themes of race, gender, and identity, and have been translated into several languages.

name: Martina McBride
about: Martina McBride is an American country music singer-songwriter and record producer. She is known for her soprano singing voice and her hit songs, such as "My Baby Loves Me," " ," and "A Broken Wing."

name: Celine Dion
about: Céline Dion has sold over 200 million records worldwide, making her one of the best-selling music artists in history. Dion's signature song, "My Heart Will Go On" from the film "Titanic" (1997), became a global hit and remains one of the best-selling singles ever.

name: Vanilla Ice
about:
Vanilla Ice is a pop idol of the early 1990s who shot to fame as the first white rapper to top the pop singles chart with his hit "Ice Ice Baby." 
 
His first album, which featured his most notable hit "Ice Ice Baby," was released in 1989. Although a huge success, his popularity was short-lived. Vanilla Ice continued with his music career, but also became involved in professional jet-skiing and reality TV shows in later years.

name: Andre Agassi
about:
One of the game's most dominant players from the early 1990s to the mid-2000s, and considered to be one of the greatest tennis players of all time.  
 
Agassi has been called the best service returner in the history of the game, and was one of tennis' most charismatic players.  
 
He is credited for helping to revive the popularity of tennis during the 1990s.  
 
He won eight majors and an Olympic gold medal.

name: Sarah Rafferty
about: Sarah Rafferty is an American actress best known for her role as Donna Paulsen on Suits. Rafferty was raised in an artistic home and attended college at Yale University. She has been acting since the early 2000s and has appeared in several television shows and films.

name: Carmen Electra
about: Carmen Electra came to fame with her appearances in Playboy magazine and her role on the television series "Baywatch" (1997-1998).

name: Marc Anthony
about: Marc Anthony is the top-selling salsa artist of all time, selling over 12 million albums, including "Contra La Corriente" (1997), "3.0" (2013) and "Opus" (2019).

name: Angelina Jolie
about:
Achieved wide fame after her portrayal of the video game heroine Lara Croft in "Lara Craft: Tomb Raider" and the sequel "The Cradle of Life". Won an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her performance in the drama "Girl, Interrupted".  
 
She has been cited as the world's most beautiful woman by various media outlets, and her relationship with   has received worldwide publicity.

name: Victoria Beckham
about: Victoria Beckham is one member of the most successful all-female pop group " ", with whom she was nicknamed "Posh Spice". The Spice Girls sold over 85 million records worldwide.

name: Jennifer Aniston
about:
Gained worldwide recognition for portraying Rachel Green on the television sitcom "Friends" (1994–2004), a role which earned her an Emmy Award, a Golden Globe Award, and a Screen Actors Guild Award.  
 
She has also enjoyed a successful film career, and has played the female protagonist in dozens of romantic comedy films.

name: Reid Hoffman
about:
Co-founder and executive chairman of LinkedIn, a social media website that connects professionals.  
 
He was also on the board of directors during the founding of PayPal.

name: John Oliver
about:
Initially a stand-up comedian, John Oliver rose to fame for his work on "The Daily Show with  ". 
 
Since 2014 he has gained widespread acclaim for his HBO show "Last Week Tonight with John Oliver" and for which he was won 6 Emmys and a Peabody award. 
 
He is also a co-host on the podcast "The Bugle".

name: Robert Downey Jr
about: Best known for his role as the Marvel superhero Iron Man in Marvel's Cinematic Universe, including three Iron Man films opposite   and the ensemble   films opposite fellow Marvel actors such as   and  .

name: Pharrell Williams
about:
Part of the record production duo called "The Neptunes" with Chad Hugo and the lead vocalist and drummer of the band N.E.R.D. 
 
Earned seven Grammy Awards including two with The Neptunes.

name: J. K. Rowling
about: J. K. Rowling is a British author and philanthropist, best known as the author of the children's fantasy series  . The series has been translated into 70 languages and sold over 500 million copies, as well as movies and video games based on the franchise.

name: Ronaldo
about: Widely considered one of the greatest football players of all time, Ronaldo received three FIFA Player of the Year Awards during his career and led Brazil to a World Cup title in 2002.

name: David Beckham
about: Beckham is one of the most recognisable soccer players of all-time, spending most of his playing career at huge clubs like Manchester United, Real Madrid, AC Milan, Paris SG and LA Galaxy.

name: Winona Ryder
about: The actress achieved early fame in her teens starring  's "Beetlejuice" (1988) and the cult comedy "Heathers" and became known for her choice of off-beat roles.

name: Christina Ricci
about: Christina Ricci came to fame as a child star and successfully transitioned to adult roles, often portraying dark and quirky characters.

name: Janet Jackson
about: The youngest of the 10 Jackson children, Janet began performing with her siblings from the age of 7, and was part of the short-lived television variety show "The Jacksons" (1976-77).

name: Shaggy
about:
Shaggy served in the US Marine Corp during the Persian Gulf War before launching his singing career. He took his stage name from the character in the TV show "Scooby-Doo".  
 
Shaggy released his debut album "Pure Pleasure" in 1993 and had hits with singles "Boombastic", "It Wasn't Me" and "Angel". His third studio album Bombastic won the Grammy for Best Reggae Album in 1996, and he repeated this in 2019 with "44/876".

name: Björk
about:
Famous initially as the lead singer of the alternative rock band "The Sugarcubes", she has developed an eclectic and avant-garde musical style over her three-decade solo career that incorporates a range of musical styles.  
 
Critics have praised her innovative approach to singing and song composition, and some believe she is the most important musician of her generation.

name: Charlie Sheen
homePlace: New York City, New York, USA
about: Charlie Sheen is an American actor who rose to fame through a series of successful films in the 1980s and 90s. He is perhaps most known for his television roles, notably on the sitcoms Spin City, where he replaced  , and Two and a Half Men, where his performance as Charlie Harper earned him several Golden Globe and Emmy Award nominations.

name: Mariah Carey
homePlace: New York City, New York, USA
about:
Came to prominence after releasing her self-titled debut studio album "Mariah Carey", which went multiplatinum and spawned four consecutive number one singles.  
 
She has sold more than 200 million records worldwide, making her one of the best-selling music artists of all time.  
 
She has won five Grammy Awards, and is famed for her five-octave vocal range.

name: Eminem
about: Marshall Bruce Mathers III, known professionally as Eminem, is an American rapper who revolutionized hip hop in Middle America and is lauded as one of the genre's greatest artists. Eminem's extensive impact included breaking racial barriers for white rappers and embodying the voice of the American underclass, transcending music boundaries and influencing artists across various genres.

name: Thom Yorke
about: Thom Yorke is an English musician best known as the lead vocalist and main songwriter of the band Radiohead. He has garnered international acclaim for his distinctive voice and experimental approach to music.

name: Lauryn Hill
about: Lauryn Hill is an American rapper and singer-songwriter best known as a member of the Fugees, alongside Wyclef Jean and Pras Michel, and for her solo album The Miseducation of Lauryn Hill.

name: Emmitt Smith
about: Emmitt Smith is an American football running back, best known for his time with the Dallas Cowboys in the National Football League (NFL). During his 15-year career, he became the NFL's all-time leading rusher, a record that still stands. Smith's powerful running style, combined with his agility and durability, made him one of the most dominant players of his era.

name: Shania Twain
about:
Referred to as "The Queen of Country Pop", she is one of the most commercially successful artists of all time, having sold over 85 million albums. She has received 5 Grammy awards.  
 
In 2004, she retired from performing due to a weakening singing voice.

name: Dolores O’Riordan
about: Dolores O’Riordan was an Irish singer and songwriter, best known as lead vocalist and lyricist for the Cranberries. The band earned worldwide fame with their hit single, "Zombie," in 1994. The song was inspired by the Troubles, the conflict in Northern Ireland from the late 1960s to 1998, in which more than 3,500 people were killed.

name: Marco Rubio
about: Marco Rubio rose from local Florida politics to become the first Hispanic U.S. Secretary of State. His journey from the son of Cuban immigrants to one of America's most influential political figures reflects the evolving landscape of American politics and the Republican Party.

name: Wayne Brady
about: He is best known for the tv series Whose Line Is It Anyway?, the talk show host of The Wayne Brady Show and Don't Forget the Lyrics!

name: Rashida Jones
about: Rashida Jones is an American actress, known for her roles in comedy television series such as The Office (2006-2009) and   (2009-2015) alongside  ,   and Rob Lowe. She was also the lead in Angie Tribeca (2016-2019).

name: Billy Corgan
about: Billy Corgan is best known for being the lead singer and guitarist of the alternative rock band The Smashing Pumpkins. Corgan has also released several solo albums, the most recent being Ogilala in 2017.

name: Ali Landry
about:
An American actress and model, Landry is best known for winning Miss USA 1996.  
 
She went on to play Rita Lefleur on the UPN sitcom Eve and had some success in modelling, particularly in the 1998 Doritos Super Bowl commercial.

name: Ron DeSantis
about: Ron DeSantis is an American politician and attorney. He served as the U.S. Representative for Florida's 6th district and later became the Governor of Florida.

name: Melania Trump
about:
Originally a fashion model from Slovenia, she married future President of the United States   in 2005.  
 
Upon her husband's election to the presidency in 2016, Trump became the First Lady of the United States.

name: Alanis Morissette
about: Alanis Morissette is a Canadian-American singer-songwriter who began her career in Canada before releasing Jagged Little Pill (1995) which sold 33 million copies worldwide. She won a Grammy Award for this album in 1996, and the album was made into a rock musical in 2017.

name: Monica Lewinsky
about: Monica Lewinsky is a former White House intern known for her involvement in a scandal with President  . She has since become an advocate against cyberbullying and a television producer.

name: Wang Dan
about: As a student leader in the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989, Wang has gone on to be a prominent member of the Chinese democracy movement. Starting off as a history student at Peking University, Wang received his Ph.D. in history from Harvard University.

name: Alexei Navalny
about: One of the main Russian opposition leaders, Navalny is the leader of the Progress Party and has been described as "the man   fears most."

name: Robin Wright
about: Known as Claire Underwood in the Netflix series   for which she won the best actress in a TV series (drama) in the 2015 Golden Globe awards.

name: Ajay Devgan
about: Ajay Devgn is an Indian actor and director renowned for his place in Indian cinema and Hindi films. Throughout his career, Devgn has starred in over 100 films and earned numerous awards, including four National Film Awards and four Filmfare Awards. In recognition of his impact on the arts, he was awarded the Padma Shri by the Government of India in 2016.

name: Robbie Williams
about:
Robbie Williams began his career as a member of the British boy band Take That, but found even greater commercial success as a solo artist.  
 
Williams was 16 years old when he joined Take That in 1989 and stayed until 1995. Williams went on to rejoin the band 2010-2014. 
 
Williams has sold more than 77 million albums and singles worldwide, and is the best-selling British solo artist in the United Kingdom and the best selling non-Latino artist in Latin America.

name: Jim Courier
about: Jim Courier is an American professional tennis player who achieved remarkable success during his career, particularly in the early 1990s. Known for his powerful baseline game and aggressive style, Courier became one of the top players in the world and a key figure in the golden era of American men's tennis.

name: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus
about: In 2017 Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus was elected Director-General of the World Health Organization. As head of the WHO during the Coronavirus COVID-19 pandemic he has played a major global  role providing countries with advice and aid to fight the virus.

name: will.i.am
about: will.i.am is an American rapper and singer who first came to fame with the Black Eyed Peas. Since then he has released four solo albums, as well as working with a number of major artists:  ,  ,  ,  ,    , and more.

name: Abby Wambach
about: Abby Wambach is an American soccer player, coach. An inductee into the National Soccer Hall of Fame, she is the all-time top scorer for the U.S. national team. She has earned further significant accolades, such as the U.S. Soccer Athlete of the Year and the FIFA World Player of the Year, as well as making her mark in four  's World Cups and two Olympic Games.

name: Gwen Stefani
about:
Co-founder and lead vocalist of the rock band "No Doubt".  
 
During the band's hiatus, she recorded "Love. Angel. Music. Baby.", her first solo studio album, in 2004.  
 
Inspired by music of the 1980s, the album was a success with sales of over seven million copies.

name: Neve Campbell
about:
Neve Campbell's most famous roles are as Julia Salinger in the TV drama series "Party of Five", and as Sidney Prescott in most of the "Scream" horror film series. 
 
Campbell began her showbiz career training to be a ballerina before having to give it up because of injury. She drew on her love of ballets, writing and starring in director  's ballet film "The Company" in 2003.

name: Bryce Harper
about: Bryce Harper is an American professional baseball player known for his achievements in Major League Baseball (MLB), particularly with the Philadelphia Phillies and the Washington Nationals.

name: Sebastian Vettel
about: Four-time Formula One World Champion, having won the championship in 2010, 2011, 2012, and 2013 with Red Bull Racing.

name: Luka Modrić
about: Widely regarded as one of the great midfielders of his generation, Modrić plays for Real Madrid and captains the Croatian national team. With the latter, he took Croatia to the 2018 Fifa World Cup Final, their first, though they lost to France. Modrić was awarded the Golden Ball for the most valuable player of the tournament.

name: Dakota Johnson
about:
The daughter of actors   and Don Johnson, the actress achieved worldwide fame on her own terms starring in the erotic Fifty Shades film series opposite  .  
 
She has gone on to star in a Netflix remake of  's novel "Persuasion".

name: Wayne Rooney
about:
England's all-time leading goalscorer, Rooney played for Manchester United between 2004 and 2017.  
 
He is one of two English football players to have won the Premier League, FA Cup, UEFA Champions League, League Cup, UEFA Europa League and FIFA Club World Cup.

name: Virat Kohli
about: Indian batsman Virat Kohli is known for his aggressive style and ability to chase runs.

name: Dylan O'Brien
about:
Dylan O'Brien is an American actor who first came to fame as Stiles Stilinski on the television series Teen Wolf (2011-2017). His character was the best friend of the eponymous "teen wolf," Scott McCall, who was played by Tyler Posey. 
 
Since then, O'Brien has gone on to star in several films. He was cast in the lead role for the Maze Runner film trilogy (2014-2018), and has also starred in Deepwater Horizon (2016), American Assassin (2017), and Bumblebee (2018).

name: Shaun White
about: Best known as the "Flying Tomato." He is a two-time Olympic gold medalist, won multiple Summer and Winter X Games medals in which he sets records for gold medals and highest overall medal count.

name: Carly Rae Jepsen
about: Carly Rae Jepsen is a Canadian singer, songwriter, and actress. She rose to international fame with her breakout hit "Call Me Maybe" (2012), which became the best-selling single of the year and reached number one in over 19 countries.

name: Juan Martín del Potro
about: Juan Martín del Potro is an Argentine tennis player best known for winning the US Open in 2009, disrupting the dominance of the Big Four— ,  , Novak Djokovic, and  . His career has been a blend of high successes, including Olympic medals, and challenges, most notably recurrent injuries.

name: Kirsten Dunst
about: Kirsten Dunst is an American actress who began her career as a child model and actress at age 3. Dunst's breakthrough came in 1994 when she starred as the child vampire Claudia in "Interview with the Vampire" opposite   and  , earning a Golden Globe nomination at age 11.

name: Adam Driver
about: Adam Driver is an American actor who came to fame as with his role on the television series Girls, which garnered him significant recognition and three Emmy nominations. His cinematic body of work is extensive, including roles in Lincoln (2012), Inside Llewyn Davis (2013), and Paterson (2016).

name: Mandy Moore
about: Mandy Moore first gained fame as a teenage pop star, releasing her debut single "Candy" in 1999, at age 15. Her debut album "So Real followed the same year.

name: Julia Michaels
about: Julia Michaels is an American singer and songwriter who first gained recognition as a songwriter working with popular artists and transitioned to a solo career that has earned her Grammy nominations in her own right.

name: Chris Hemsworth
about: Chris Hemsworth is best known for his role as Thor in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

name: Kevin Durant
about:
One the highest paid basketball players ever Durant has won two NBA Championships in 2017 and 2018 with the Golden State Warriors. He was named NBA Finals MVP both times. 
 
Durant has also won three Olympic gold medals with Team USA in 2012, 2016 and 2020.

name: Natalie Portman
about: Mainstream success came when she was cast as Padmé Amidala in the " " prequel trilogy. Her performance in "Black Swan" received critical praise and earned her a second Golden Globe Award and the Academy Award for Best Actress in 2011.

name: Zendaya
about: Zendaya started working as a child model with a clothing line called Kid's World. She appeared as a backup dancer in various music videos for   and  . In 2010, she was cast as one of the lead roles in the Disney Channel sitcom Shake It Up. The show premiered in November 2010 and ended in 2013.

name: Jon Batiste
about: Jon Batiste is an American singer and songwriter, best known for having performed as bandleader and musical director on The Late Show with   from 2015 until 2022. He has also recorded and performed with many major artists, including Prince,  ,  , and  .

name: Lea Michele
about: Lea Michele is an American actress best known for her role as Rachel Berry on the television series Glee (2009–2015). She is also known for her work on Broadway, including her debut as Young Cosette in Les Misérables (1995–1996) and her role as Wendla Bergmann in the original cast of "Spring Awakening" (2006–2008).

name: Jimin
about: Jimin is a vocalist and dancer with the phenomenally popular Korean K-pop band BTS, making his debut with the boy band in 2013.

name: Charlie Puth
about: Charlie Puth is an American singer, songwriter and record producer. He is best known for his hit single "See You Again" featuring Wiz Khalifa, which peaked at number one on the US Billboard Hot 100 and stayed there for 12 weeks. He has released three studio albums, Nine Track Mind (2016), Voicenotes (2018) and The Distance (2020).

name: Joss Stone
about:
Joss Stone is a British soul singer, songwriter, and actress. She rose to fame in the early 2000s with her debut album, The Soul Sessions, which went multi-platinum in the UK.  
 
Stone has since released five more studio albums, with her most recent, Water for Your Soul, released in 2015.  
 
In addition to her music career, Stone has also appeared in a number of films and television shows, including Eragon, The Tudors, and Lip Service.

name: Daniel Radcliffe
about:
Daniel Radcliffe was chosen for the role of   aged 11, in the film based on the books by J.K. Rowling. He portrayed this character over 10 years and through eight successful films.  
 
Post Harry Potter Radcliffe has continued to act in both film and theatre, as well as publicly support a number of charities.

name: Alex Ovechkin
about: Alexander Ovechkin is a Russian ice hockey player, best known as left winger and captain for the Washington Capitals. He is commonly considered one of the all-time greatest goal-scorers, ending  's 31-year reign for most career goals.

name: Jessica Biel
about: Biel began her career as a vocalist, appearing in musical productions until she was cast as Mary Camden in the family-drama series 7th Heaven," for which she achieved recognition.

name: Priyanka Chopra
about: Priyanka Chopra rose to fame winning Miss India and Miss World in 2000.

name: Melanie Martinez
about: Melanie Martinez is an American singer-songwriter who first came to fame after appearing on the television show The Voice in 2012. She is known for doll-like aesthetic and emotive facial expressions, as well as her preference for thematic albums.

name: Macklemore
about: Macklemore is an American rapper and songwriter who gained mainstream fame with his 2012 album The Heist, produced in collaboration with Ryan Lewis. Their breakout single, "Thrift Shop," was a chart-topping hit and went on to win several awards, including two Grammy Awards.

name: Eliud Kipchoge
about: Kipchoge is one of the world's great distance runners.

name: Ivanka Trump
homePlace: New York City, New York, USA
about:
An American businesswoman and former fashion model, Ivanka Trump currently acts as assistant to US President  .  
 
Married to  , Trump is also the Executive Vice President of Development and Acquisitions at the Trump Organisation, and manages her own line of fashion items.

name: Katy Perry
about: One of the best-selling artists of all time, having sold more than 11 million albums in the United States and 81 million singles worldwide. She has six quintuple-platnium certified singles in the US, more than any other artist.

name: Rafael Nadal
about: Widely regarded as one of the greatest professional tennis players of all time, winning numerous Grand Slam singles titles.

name: Misty Copeland
about:
Considered a prodigy, Copeland started dancing only at the age of 13 and quickly rose to stardom.  
 
She danced for American Ballet Theatre (ABT), one of the three leading classical ballet companies in the United States, from 2000 to 2025, becoming the company's first Black female principal dancer in 2015. 
 
She has also written several books - memoirs, children's literature, and instructional titles all-centered on the dance experience.

name: Future [Nayvadius Wilburn]
about: Future is an American rapper known for his use of melody and auto-tune in trap music. He has released several major albums, including Pluto (2012) and Honest (2014). These have included platinum singles such as "I Won" featuring   and "Move That Dope" featuring Pharell Williams and Pusha T.

name: Nick Jonas
about: Nick Jonas started his entertainment career aged 7 on Broadway. He went on to form the band "The Jonas Brothers" with his brothers Joe and Kevin, releasing their debut album in 2006. The band went on to release four albums.

name: Stephen Curry
about:
Many basketball players have called Stephen Curry the greatest shooter in NBA history.  
 
In 2015, Curry won the NBA Most Valuable Player Award and led the Golden State Warriors to their first championship since 1975.

name: PewDiePie
about:
The most subscribed and viewed YouTuber, PewDiePie has approximately 57 million subscribers as of November 2017. He is most well known for his Let's Play video game playthroughs. 
 
As of November 2017 his channel has received over 16 billion video views, the most on the site. In 2016 Time named him as one of the most influential people in the world.

name: Donald Glover
homePlace: Edwards Air Force Base, California, USA
about: Glover co-created and stars in the acclaimed FX show Atlanta, and has appeared in numerous other films and shows, including Solo: A   Story, Community, The Martian and the live action remake of  .

name: Scarlett Johansson
homePlace: New York City, New York, USA
about: Considered one of Hollywood's modern sex symbols, and has frequently appeared in published lists of the sexiest women in the world, most notably when she was named the "Sexiest Woman Alive" by Esquire magazine in both 2006 and 2013 (the only woman to be chosen for the title twice).

name: Colin Kaepernick
about: Colin Kaepernick is best known for kneeling during the national anthem while quarterback for the San Francisco 49ers to protest racial injustice and police brutality.

name: Bruno Mars
about:
Became recognized as a solo artist after lending his vocals to the songs "Nothin' on You" by B.o.B, and "Billionaire" by Travie McCoy, which were worldwide successes.  
 
Mars has received many awards and nominations for his work as a solo artist, including two Grammy Awards.

name: Lizzo
about: Lizzo, real name Melissa Jefferson, was both a classically trained flutist and rapper when she released her debut album "Lizzobangers" in 2013. More albums have followed including her 2019 breakout Grammy-winning album "Cuz I Love You" and her music has become more diverse, developing to include R&B, gospel and pop elements.

name: Doja Cat
about: Doja Cat is an American rapper and singer whose career started with releasing self-made music on Soundcloud as a teenager, she was then picked up by Kemosabe and RCA records and signed a record deal at sixteen.

name: Miranda Lambert
about: Miranda Lambert is an American singer and songwriter. She began writing songs at the age of 16 and soon after, started performing with her father’s country band.

name: T-Pain
about: T-Pain is an American rapper, singer, songwriter, and record producer. He gained fame for popularizing the use of Auto-Tune in music, a signature element of his style.

name: Hilary Duff
about: Established as a teen idol after being cast in the Disney Channel television series "Lizzie McGuire" in the early 2000s and its motion picture "The Lizzie McGuire Movie" (2003), in which she portrayed the titular character. She later appeared in feature films and numerous television dramas and comedies.

name: Daisy Ridley
about: Ridley reached prominence to a global audience with her role as Rey in the   sequel trilogy, The Force Awakens (2015) and The Last Jedi (2017) and an as-yet unreleased third film.

name: Kelly Clarkson
about: Kelly Clarkson is an American who came to fame in 2002 after winning the first season of American Idol. Her first single, 'A Moment Like This' (2002), topped the US Billboard Hit 100 and was the best-selling single of that year. She then released her debut album, Thankful (2003), which topped the Billboard 200.

name: Demi Lovato
about: Demi Lovato was a child actor starting out in the children's show "Barney & Friends" alongside  . In 2007 Lovato starting working for the Disney Channel and starred in the popular "Camp Rock" films with the Jonas Brothers. She also recorded songs for the movie soundtrack.

name: Anne Hathaway
homePlace: New York City, New York, USA
about: Anne Hathaway is best known her Oscar-winning performance in "Les Misérables" (2012). She rose to fame as a teenager and successfully transitioned to adult roles, becoming one of Hollywood's highest-paid actresses.

name: Adele
homePlace: Tottenham, Greater London, England, United Kingdom
about: One of the best-selling artists in musical history, Adele was the first female in the history of the Billboard Hot 100 to have three singles in the top 10 at the same time as a lead artist.

name: Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya
about: Prior to her political career, Tsikhanouskaya was an English teacher and interpreter. Her husband, Sergei Tikhanovsky, had intended to run for president; then when he was arrested, Sviatlana announced that she intended to run in his place.

name: Breonna Taylor
about: Breonna Taylor was an African American emergency medical technician who tragically lost her life in a controversial incident that sparked widespread protests in the United States. On March 13, 2020, Taylor was fatally shot by Louisville Metro Police Department officers during a raid on her apartment. This event became a major touchstone in the struggle against police violence and systemic racism.

name: LeAnn Rimes
about: LeeAnn Rimes began singing and performing as a child and was only 13 years old wen she released the single "Blue" written by Billy Mack. The song and the album, also called "Blue", made her famous and her voice was compared to country music legend  . Rimes went on to win three Grammy awards, best new artist, best country song, & best country female vocal performance in 1997.

name: Andy Murray
about: Andy Murray is a British tennis player from Scotland, having been ranked world number one for 41 weeks in 2016. He has won twice at Wimbledon (2013, 2016) and once at the US Open (2012).

name: Usain Bolt
about: Usain Bolt was the fastest man in history. He won eight Olympic gold medals and set world records in the 100-meter and 200-meter races.

name: Holly Valance
about: Holly Valance is an Australian model, actress, and singer best known for her roles as Felicity Scully on the Australian soap opera Neighbours (1999–2002) and Nika Volek in Prison Break (2005–2006). She has also had a music career, with several hit singles.

name: Miranda Kerr
about: Miranda Kerr is an Australian supermodel who gained international recognition when she became one of Victoria's Secret Angels in 2007, the first Australian in the history of the company.

name: Miley Cyrus
about: Went from being a teen (and even pre-teen) idol in the TV series  "Hannah Montana" to being a successful adult entertainer.

name: Kristen Stewart
about: Kristen Stewart rose to fame playing Bella Swan in the   series of films released 2008-2012. The films were based on the books by Stephanie Meyer and co-starred her then boyfriend   and Taylor Lautner. The books phenomenal popularity was equalled on film and the films have made $3.3 billion worldwide.

name: Prince Harry
about:
As the second son of  , and  , Prince Harry is currently fifth in line to the throne. 
 
Having served in the British Army for ten years (2005-15), Prince Harry is also involved with several charity organizations including the charity Sentebale, which he co-founded with Prince Seeiso to support orphans and vulnerable children in Lesotho.

name: Kim Jong-un
about: Kim Jong Un is the leader of North Korea and the third generation of the Kim dynasty to rule the country. He has overseen significant advancements in North Korea's nuclear weapons program and engaged in high-profile diplomacy with world leaders.

name: Brie Larson
about: Brie Larson began her film career in films such as "21 Jump Street" (2012) and "Short Term 12" (2013).

name: Janelle Monáe
about:
Janelle Monáe is an American singer and actress whose career started with the release of her demo album The Audition in 2003. She has won the Billboard Women in Music Rising Star Award in 2015 and has been nominated for 8 Grammy Awards. 
 
She rose to fame properly in 2007 with her EP titled Metropolis: Suite I (The Chase). Monáe has since released several studio albums, including The ArchAndroid (2010) and Dirty Computer (2018). These albums have been received with critical acclaim.

name: Michael Phelps
about: Michael Phelps holds the record for the most Olympic medals (28) and gold medals (23) won by any athlete in history.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
about: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, also commonly known by her initials AOC, was the youngest woman at 29 ever be elected to the US House of Representatives.

name: Ariana Grande
about:
Reached mainstream success after the release of her debut studio album, Yours Truly (2013), which debuted at number one on the U.S. Billboard 200.  
 
Her second studio album, My Everything (2014), produced the hit singles "Problem" and "Break Free".

name: Avril Lavigne
about:
Lavigne is known for her punk-rock-influenced pop music and her iconic fashion style that sparked the "skater-punk" trend of the early 2000s.  
 
Her first album ("Let Go") was released in 2002 and has sold over 15 million copies worldwide. She has sold more than 30 million albums and over 50 million singles worldwide. 
 
Her hit singles include "Complicated," "Sk8er Boi," and "Girlfriend."

name: Justin Bieber
about:
Discovered on YouTube in 2007, Justin Bieber has become one of the most popular recording artists in the world.  
 
He was the first artist to have seven songs from a debut record to chart on the "Billboard Hot 100".

name: Billie Piper
about: Billie Piper is a British singer and actress best known for her performance as Rose Tyler on the cult television show Doctor Who.

name: Drake
about:
Initially gaining fame as an actor for his appearances on the Canadian teen show Degrassi, Drake eventually became one of the most successful recording artists of the 21st century. His album Views (2016) broke several records and contained a number of hit songs including "Hotline Bling". 
 
His follow-up albums, including the mixtape More Life and the album Scorpion both broke several streaming records and created a number of hits.

name: Novak Đoković
about: Novak Djokovic holds the record for most Grand Slam men's singles titles with 24 and has spent a record 373 weeks ranked as world number one. Djokovic is the only player to achieve the "Career Golden Masters" by winning all nine Masters 1000 tournaments.

name: Emilia Clarke
about: Emilia Clarke is a British actress best known for her portrayal of Daenerys Targaryen in the television series   (2011–2019). Clarke pursued acting from an early age, influenced by a musical she saw at three years old. She trained at Drama Centre London, graduating in 2009, and thereafter embarked on a career that saw her achieve major success on both stage and screen.

name: Jennifer Hudson
about: Jennifer Hudson, also known as "J.Hud", first gained national attention as a contestant on "American Idol" in 2004. Her 2006 feature film debut in "Dreamgirls" earned her an Academy Award. In 2008, her eponymous solo debut album won a Grammy Award for Best R&B Album.

name: Gal Gadot
about:
Famous as the most recent actress to play the DC superhero Wonder  Woman on screen, appearing in "Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice" (2016) before starring in "Woman Woman" (2017) directed by Patty Jenkins opposite Chris Pine. 
 
Gadot rose to fame after winning the Miss Israel title in 2004 and becoming a model. She moved into acting landing a role in the  Fast and the Furious film franchise with the 4th film in the series "Fast and Furious" (2009).

name: Karolína Kurková
about: Karolína Kurková is a Czech model and actress best known for her work as a former Victoria's Secret Angel and Vogue cover model.

name: Britney Spears
about: Britney Spears is an American singer, dancer, and actress, who became one of the most successful and influential pop artists of the late 1990s and early 2000s. She released her debut album, "Baby One More Time", in 1999, which topped the charts and quickly established her as a pop icon.

name: Emma Watson
about: Emma Watson is a British actress, model, and activist, best known for her portrayal of Hermione Granger in the   film series. The role of Hermione, which she played from the age of eleven, brought her international fame and prominence within the film industry. Alongside her acting career, Watson has become a prominent advocate for women's rights and gender equality.

name: Patrick Mahomes
about:
Mahomes is the second youngest quarterback (after  ) to win the Super Bowl. This gave the Kansas City Chiefs their first win since 1970, for which performance Mahomes was also awarded the Super Bowl MVP.  
 
His father is MLB pitcher Pat Mahomes, and the younger Mahomes had begun sport with college baseball alongside football — ultimately taking his own path after choosing to focus on football.

name: Emma Stone
about: Emma Stone is an American actress whose career began with a part in the television series In Search of the New Partridge Family. She quickly transitioned to film and her breakout role came in the comedy Superbad (2007), which led to a series of successful films, including Zombieland (2009) and Easy A (2010), the latter earning her a Golden Globe nomination for Best Actress.

name: Lorde
about:
New Zealand singer-songwriter who signed with Universal Music Group at only 13, and was later paired with songwriter and record producer Joel Little.  
 
Her debut work "The Love Club EP" was commercially released in March 2013 and included the song "Royals", which became an international crossover hit and won two Grammy Awards.

name: Amy Winehouse
about: Amy Winehouse was an English singer and songwriter, known for her distinctive vocal style and eclectic mix of genres. She had a major hit with the 2006 song "Rehab."

name: Mark Zuckerberg
about: Mark Zuckerberg co-founded Facebook and serves as the current CEO of its parent company, Meta Platforms. He is currently the 4th richest person in the world, with a net worth of $176 billion in June of 2024.

name: Lionel Messi
about:
Commonly ranked as the best player in the world and rated by some in the sport as the greatest of all time.  
 
He holds numerous records, and has played for FC Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain and Inter Miami.  
 
In 2014, he led Argentina to the FIFA World Cup finals and in 2022 to World Cup victory.

name: Ed Sheeran
about: One of the most successful artists of the 21st century, Sheeran has released three studio albums to date: "+" (plus), "x" (multiply) and "%" (divide). These albums have been incredibly successful commercially and have been critically well-received.

name: Serena Williams
about:
Widely regarded as one of the greatest female tennis players in history and only female player to have won over $50 million in prize money.  
 
Winning a total of 32 Major titles 17 in singles, 13 in women's doubles, and 2 in mixed doubles.

name: Caroline Shaw
about: Caroline Shaw is best known for winning the Pulitzer Prize for Music at age 30, making her the youngest recipient of this award.

name: Beyoncé
about: Rose to fame in the late 1990s as lead singer of R&B girl-group Destiny's Child.

name: Rihanna
about:
Rihanna is one of the most successful singers of all time and her records have sold over 230 million copies worldwide.  
 
Her many hit singles include "Umbrella", "Disturbia", "Don't Stop the Music", and  "Love the Way You Lie". Rihanna has won 8 Grammys and had 14 No. 1 singles on the US Billboard Hot 100

name: Alexis Ohanian
about: Alexis Ohanian is an American entrepreneur and investor, best known as the co-founder of the social news website Reddit. Together with Steve Huffman, he created Reddit in 2005 as part of the first class of the startup incubator, Y Combinator. The platform quickly grew in popularity and was sold to Condé Nast in 2006, although Ohanian continued to be involved with the website in various capacities.

name: Dua Lipa
about: Dua Lipa was born to Kosovo Albanian parents and although born and mostly reared in England, she spent some of her teen years in Kosovo, learning to speak Albanian and learning more about her heritage.

name: Chrissy Teigen
about: Chrissy Teigen is known for her diverse career, outspoken nature, and relationship with musician  .

name: Alessandra Ambrosio
homePlace: Erechim, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil
about: Alessandra Ambrosio is a Brazilian supermodel and actress who gained international fame as a Victoria's Secret Angel from 2004 to 2017.

name: Thora Birch
about: Known for the Academy Award-winning film, " " and for her starring role in the 2001 black comedy film "Ghost World".

name: Mike Krieger
about: Mike Krieger is an American entrepreneur and software engineer best known for founding Instagram alongside  . Krieger further served as CTO of Instagram during its early years, in which time the company reached 1 billion monthly users.

name: Lady Gaga
homePlace: New York City, New York, USA
about:
Rose to prominence with her debut album The Fame (2008), a critical and commercial success.  
 
Best known for her flamboyant and diverse contributions to the music industry via her fashion, live performances, and music videos.  
 
She is one of the best-selling musicians of all time, with global album and single sales of 27 million and 125 million.

name: Meghan Markle
about: Markle rose to fame as the Rachel Zane on the hit US television series Suits, which she starred in from 2011 until leaving the show in 2017.

name: Roger Federer
about:
Widely regarded as the greatest tennis player of all time.  
 
He holds several men's world records of the Open Era, such as holding the world no. 1 position for 302 weeks overall (including a 237-consecutive-week stretch at the top from 2004 to 2008), winning 17 Grand Slam singles titles, and reaching each Grand Slam Final at least five times.

name: Tessa Thompson
about: Tessa Thompson began her acting career on the stage before later appearing in guest TV roles. She made her film debut in 2006, moving on to leading roles with the comedy "Dear White People" (2014) and Ryan Coogler's Rocky sequel "Creed" (2015).

name: Prince George
about: Prince George of Cambridge is the eldest child of  , Duke of Cambridge, and Catherine,  .

name: Brock Purdy
about: Brock Purdy is an American football quarterback, best known for playing with the San Francisco 49ers. Starting as the final pick in the 2022 NFL Draft, he defied expectations by leading his team to significant victories, including a division title and an appearance at the NFC Championship Game. His success continued into his second season, where he made a mark by setting franchise records and being selected for the Pro Bowl.

name: Cody Simpson
about: Cody Simpson is an Australian singer and swimmer. His musical career began with recording songs for YouTube in his bedroom. He came to international fame after releasing his debut single "iYiYi" in 2010, which featured Flo Rida.

name: Conan Gray
about: Conan Gray is an American singer, songwriter, and YouTuber. He gained fame in 2017 after releasing his debut single "Idle Town". Gray is known for his unique blend of alternative and pop music, which has earned him millions of devoted fans around the world.

name: Jake Paul
about:
A highly successful YouTuber with some 13 million subscribers, he and his older brother   initially rose to fame on the video sharing service Vine, before it went defunct. 
 
Since then he has become well known for his role on the Disney series Bizaardvark.

name: Billie Eilish
about: Eilish began her career in 2016 by releasing the song "Ocean Eyes" on SoundCloud before being signed by Interscope Records and Darkroom.

name: Dylan Wang
about: Dylan Wang is a Chinese actor and singer known for his roles in Meteor Garden (2018) and Love Between Fairy and Devil (2022). He rose to fame after winning the reality television competition Super Idol in 2017.

name: Zara Larsson
about:
Zara first gained notice in 2008 when, at 10 years old, she won the second season of the nationwide Swedish television talent show "Talange". 
 
She has since released three albums and had many hit singles in here native country, as well as a pair of international top ten songs - "Lush Life" and "Never Forget You". 
 
She considers herself an activist and uses literal and virtual stages to advocate for feminist, human rights, and social causes.

name: Lil Mosey
about:
Lil Mosey is an American rapper, best known for his 2017 single "Pull Up." He then released his debut studio album Northsbest (2018) which featured the Billboard Hot 100 single "Noticed." He has since released further music, including his second album titled Certified Hitmaker (2019). 
 
In 2021, Mosey was charged with second degree rape in Washington for which he was ultimately cleared of all charges in March, 2023.

name: Juice WRLD
about:
Juice WRLD, born Jarad Anthony Higgins, was an American rapper signed with Interscope Records. He was best known for a number of hit singles including "Lucid Dreams" and "All Girls Are the Same."  
 
Higgins died in 2019 after a drug overdose, after which a posthumous album was released titled Legends Never Die (2020). A second posthumous album titled Fighting Demons was released in 2021, as well as a documentary film.

name: Finn Wolfhard
about: Finn Wolfhard is a Canadian actor and musician. He is best known for his roles in the Netflix shows   and The Willoughbys, as well as his work in the film adaptations of It and  .  He has also appeared in several music videos and is the lead vocalist for the band Calpurnia.

name: Liza Soberano
about: Liza Soberano is a Filipino-American actress and model. She began her career in show business at a young age, appearing in minor roles and advertisements, and rose to fame after starring in the romantic comedy television series Forevermore (2014-2015).

name: Chappell Roan
about: Known for her drag-queen persona and aesthetic, Chappell Roan rose to global stardom in 2024 with her single "Good Luck, Babe!", which reached number four on the US Billboard Hot 100. The success of her single became a catalyst for her debut studio album, "The Rise and Fall of a Midwest Princess" (2023), topping the charts worldwide.

name: XXXTentacion
about: During his short career, XXXTentacion was a magnet for controversy but also had an enormous impact on his youthful fanbase. He began writing music after his release from a juvenile detention center, and became a leading figure of the 'SoundCloud rap' genre, after uploading a number of songs to the music website.

name: Angourie Rice
about: Angourie Rice is an Australian actress known for her breakout roles in "The Nice Guys" (2016) and "Spider-Man: Homecoming" (2017).

name: Adut Akech
about: Adut Akech Bior is a South Sudanese model whose career began with a debut at the Saint Laurent S/S 17 show. She quickly rose to prominence with two more shows for the iconic brand. She was recognized with two "Model of the Year" awards from models.com, and celebrated as one of the industry's "New Supers."

name: Chloë Grace Moretz
about: Chloë Grace Moretz first came to fame at a young age for her role as Hit-Girl in "Kick-Ass" (2010).

name: David Hogg
about: Hogg rose to prominence after surviving a mass shooting at the Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Florida on February 14, 2018, in which 17 people were killed.

name: Kylian Mbappé
about: Mbappé is regarded as one of the best football players in the world, being particularly notable for his dribbling, speed and finishing style. He made his debut in 2015, aged 16, and currently plays for Paris-Saint Germain as well as for the French national team.

name: Carlos Alcaraz
about: Carlos Alcaraz became the youngest world No. 1 in ATP ranking history. He is known for his rapid rise in professional tennis and his record-breaking achievements at a young age.

name: Margo Hayes
about: Margo Hayes is a American rock climber best known as the first woman to successfully climb a route graded 9a+ (5.15a) in 2017. Her 2019 completion of the "9a+ Trilogy" established her as one of the preeminent figures within the climbing community.

name: Caitlin Clark
about: Caitlin Clark is an American college basketball player best known for her dominant performances with the Iowa Hawkeyes. As of her senior season, she became the NCAA Division I women's all-time leading scorer and is projected to be a top pick in the 2024 WNBA draft.

name: Lamar Jackson
about: Lamar Jackson is an American football player, best known as quarterback for the Baltimore Ravens. He began his career in college football, during which time he won the Heisman Trophy.

name: Natalia Grossman
about: Natalia Grossman is an American rock climber who has made several podium finishes in IFSC Climbing World Cup events, as well as winning medals at the World Championships and secured her spot in the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris with a victory at the 2023 Pan American Games.

name: Baby Ariel
about: Baby Ariel came to fame on the app Musical.ly, now known as TikTok. She became one of the most influential young people on the internet, with millions of followers across various platforms.

name: Brooke Raboutou
about: Brooke Raboutou is an American rock climber who is a member of the US National Team and has competed at the 2020 Summer Olympics. Her career in IFSC Climbing World Cups has been marked by impressive performances that underscore her status as a rising star in the climbing world.

name: Lil Pump
about: Lil Pump rose to fame in 2018 with his song "Gucci Gang" and with his eponymous debut album released in 2017. He further gained attention with his song "Welcome to the Party" which was featured in the Deadpool 2 movie.

name: Katie Ledecky
about:
Katie Ledecky has won more Olympic swimming medals than any other female swimmer. In 2012 at the London Olympics aged 15 she won the  women's 800-metre freestyle. At the 2016 Rio Olympics she was won more medals than any other female athlete at the Games - 4 golds and 1 silver.  
 
Ledecky also has won 14 world championship titles and broken 13 world records.

name: Kylie Jenner
about: Jenner came to fame initially by starring in the reality television show   (2007-present), which became a major success for the E! network. Showing an early interest in fashion and cosmetics, she worked with her sister   to produce a line of clothing.

name: Marcus Rashford
about:
Marcus Rashford is an English footballer, best known for playing as a forward for Manchester United in the Premier League as well as for the English national team. 
 
Rashford debuted for England in 2016, in which match he broke the record for the youngest English player to score in his first international match at just 18 years old.

name: Janja Garnbret
about: Janja Garnbret is a Slovenian rock climber, who was the first female Olympic gold medalist in climbing, which she achieved in 2021. By 2023, she had further secured a record-breaking number of IFSC gold medals.

name: Elle Fanning
about: Elle Fanning is an American actress who began her career at a young age. While she was initially known more as the younger sister of fellow actress  , she has since come into recognition in her own right.

name: Chloe Kim
about: Chloe Kim is best known for her exceptional skills in the halfpipe event. She is a two-time Olympic gold medalist in snowboarding and has further set numerous records in the sport.

name: Lonzo Ball
about: Lonzo Ball is an American basketball player, best known for his currently playing with the Bulls as a point guard. Ball's two brothers are both also professional basketball players, with LaMelo Ball playing for the Charlotte Hornets and LiAngelo Ball playing for the Greensboro Swarm.

name: Alexander Zverev
about:
Alexander Zverev is a German tennis player, who has remained in the world top 10 since 2017 and has ranked as high as world number 2. He has won titles at the ATP Finals in 2018 and 2021, as well as a gold medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics. 
 
Zverev's older brother, Mischa Zverev, is also a professional tennis player.

name: Lily-Rose Depp
about: Lily-Rose Depp is the daughter of famous actors   and Vanessa Paradis. Depp started acting at a young age and has starred in both independent and mainstream films.

name: NBA YoungBoy
about: NBA YoungBoy, also known as YoungBoy Never Broke Again, is an American rapper that came to fame with a series of mixtapes that led to a cult following. He was then signed to Atlantic Records, releasing his first hit single "Outside Today" (2018) and his debut studio album Until Death Call My Name (2018).

name: Jack Harlow
about: Jack Harlow is an American rapper who first came to fame with the success of his single "Whats Poppin" (2020) on TikTok. He went on to produce a remix of this single with DaBaby, Tory Lanez, and  , which reached number two on the US Billboard Hot 100 and received a Grammy nomination.

name: Rashid Khan
about: Rashid Khan is an Afghan cricketer who has set numerous records, including fastest bowler to reach 50 T20I wickets and youngest to captain a Test team.

name: Lando Norris
about: Lando Norris drives for the British motor-racing team McLaren in Formula One. He has currently won eight Grands Prix across seven seasons. Norris won his first Grand Prix at the 2024 Miami Grand Prix and was runner-up in the Formula One World Drivers' Championship in 2024.

name: Willow Smith
about: Willow Smith is an American singer and actress, best known as the daughter of actors   and  . Her brother,  , has also become famous as a rapper and actor.

name: Luka Dončić
about: Luka Dončić is a Slovenian basketball player, best known for playing on the Dallas Mavericks and for the Slovenian national team. He won Rookie of the Year for the 2018-2019 season and then was selected for the NBA All-Star game in the next three seasons.

name: Sophia Lillis
about: Sophia Lillis is an American actress, best known for playing Beverley Marsh in It (2017) and It: Chapter Two (2019). She has also starred in further films, such as Gretel & Hansel (2020), as well as television series, including I Am Not Okay With This (2020) and Sharp Objects (2018).

name: Maisie Williams
about:
Maisie Williams rose to fame in the role of Arya Stark in the HBO fantasy television series " ". This was her first performance role, she was nominated for an Emmy in it in 2016. 
 
Williams also has a recurring role in the British sci-fi TV series "Doctor Who".

name: Peyton Elizabeth Lee
about:
Peyton Elizabeth Lee rose to fame acting in the Disney Channel series "Andi Mack" (2017-19), at one point the top-rated cable show for children 6-12 years. 
 
Since 2020 Lee has starred in further Disney channel shows "Secret Society of Second Born Royals" (2020_ and "Doogie" Kamealoha", a remake of Doogie Howser M.D. that starred originally  .

name: Lewis Koumas
about: Lewis Koumas is an English footballer, closely watched for his emerging talent. As the son of former Wales international footballer  , Koumas is expected to continue his father's legacy.

name: Isabel May
about: Isabel May is an American actress who is best known for her role as Elsa Dutton, the narrator and protagonist of the Paramount+ series "1883" (2021) and the narrator of its sequel "1923" (2022-2024).

name: Kiernan Shipka
about: Kiernan Shipka is an American actress who first came to fame as a child actress, playing Sally Draper on the critically acclaimed series "Mad Men" (2007-2015), for which she won two Screen Actors Guild Awards as part of the ensemble cast.

name: Lalisa
about:
Lalisa Manobal, also known as Lisa, is a Thai rapper, singer, and dancer who came to fame with the South Korean girl group Blackpink alongside Jisoo, Jennie, and Rosé. She has since also set out upon an extremely successful solo career. 
 
Her debut solo album, Lalisa, was released in 2021 and sold over 700,000 copies within South Korea during the first week of its release. Lisa's lead single,  also called Lalisa, went on to break 73 million views in the first 24-hours.

name: Bella Thorne
about: Bella Thorne is an American actress, singer, and writer who rose to fame as a child actress. Notable for her work in TV series like Dirty Sexy Money and My Own Worst Enemy, for which she won a Young Artist Award, Thorne later rose to wider prominence through her role in the Disney Channel series Shake It Up.

name: Roddy Ricch
about: Roddy Ricch is an American rapper who was first known for his hit single "Die Young" (2018), since which time he has featured on a number of hit songs: Nipsey Hussle's "Racks in the Middle" (2019), for which he won a Grammy, and Mustard's "Ballin'" (2019).

name: Khalid [Donnel Robinson]
about: Khalid is an American singer and songwriter whose debut studio album, American Teen (2017) was certified platinum and featured several hit singles including "Location" and "Young Dumb & Broke."

name: Jungkook
about: Jungkook is a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper, and producer. He is a member of the boy group BTS.

name: Lil Nas X
about: Montero Lamar Hill adopted the stage name Lil Nas X in tribute to the rapper Nas when he started he music career in 2018. His rise to fame was swift, he released the mega single "Old Town Road" in December of 2018 and through its popularity on social media platform TikTok became No. 1 for a record 19 weeks.

name: Olivia Rodrigo
about: Olivia Rodrigo is an American singer and actress. She is known for her roles in the Disney Channel series Bizaardvark.

name: Ai Mori
about: Ai Mori is a Japanese rock climber known for her accomplishments in lead climbing and bouldering on the international stage. She has secured victories at the World Cup and medals at the World Championships, making her one of the youngest Japanese athletes to achieve such a feat.

name: Lydia Ko
about:
The youngest person ever to win a professional golf tour event  and youngest person ever to win an LPGA Tour event. 
 
As an amateur she was the top-ranked woman amateur golfer in the world for 130 weeks and never missed a cut in 25 professional tournaments.  
 
In August 2013, she became the only amateur to win two LPGA Tour events.

name: Rowan Blanchard
about: Rowan Blanchard is an American actress and activist. She gained fame for her role as Riley Matthews on the Disney Channel series Girl Meets World (2014–2017) and for her work in films such as Spy Kids: All the Time in the World (2011) and A Wrinkle in Time (2018).

name: Jenna Ortega
about:
Jenna Ortega began her acting career as a child aged nine. She went on to star in Disney series "Stuck in the Middle" and slasher films "Scream" (2022) and "Scream VI" (2023).  
 
But it was the Netflix series "Wednesday" that catapulted her to international fame. Produced and partly directed by  , the series was a huge hit and Ortega was nominated at both a Golden Globe and an Emmy awards.

name: Jacob Sartorius
about: Sartorius rose to fame on the social media apps musical.ly and Tik-Tok, where people lip-sync music videos. After gaining recognition he released the single "Sweatshirt" in 2016, which reached the Hot 100.

name: Shawn Mendes
about:
Mendes fame began in 2015 when he released his debut EP "Handwritten", containing the song "Stitches", which reached number 1 in the UK.  
 
His follow-up album "Illuminate" the following year contained the No. 1 singles "Treat You Better" and "There's Nothing Holdin' Me Back" which were hits around the world. 
 
He released his third self-titled album in 2018 which included the No. 1 hit "In My Blood."

name: Malala Yousafzai
about: Famous for her human rights advocacy for the education of women in her native Swat Valley in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province of northwest Pakistan, where the local Taliban had at times banned girls from attending school.

name: Camila Cabello
about: Born in Cuba of Mexican and Cuban heritage, Camilla Cabello moved to Miami, Florida as a child. While still a teenager she auditioned for "The X Factor USA" during which she became part of girl group Fifth Harmony, the group finished third. After the series the group was signed by   and achieved two top ten hits in the US including "Work From Home.

name: Simone Biles
about: The most decorated American gymnast, Biles is a three-time world all-around champion (2013–15), three-time world floor champion (2013–15), two-time world balance beam champion (2014, 2015), four-time United States national all-around champion (2013–16), and a member of the gold medal-winning American teams at the 2014 and 2015 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships.

name: Charli D'Amelio
about: Charli D'Amelio is an American social media personality and dancer. She rose to fame on TikTok, becoming the most-followed creator on the platform in March 2020, and has since expanded her career into the mainstream.

name: Naomi Osaka
about:
Japanese tennis player Naomi Osaka is the first Asian player to reach the No. 1 women's world ranking in tennis. Of Japanese and Haitian decent, Osaka was born in Japan but brought up mostly in America.  
 
She is the winner of two grand slam tournaments, the US Open, defeating   in 2018 and the Australian Open in 2019.

name: Max Verstappen
about: Verstappen, whose father Jos Verstappen was also a Formula One driver, is the youngest ever Formula One driver—with his debut in the 2015 Australian Grand Prix at 17 years old.

name: MrBeast
about: MrBeast, whose real name is Jimmy Donaldson, is an American YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is best known for his YouTube videos featuring elaborate stunts, challenges, and large-scale giveaways, which have made him the most-subscribed individual creator on the platform.

name: Khaby Lame
about:
Khaby Lame is a Senegalese-born Italian social media personality, best known for his satirical TikTok videos. His is current the most-followed account on TikTok, surpassing   in June 2022. 
 
Lame was born in Senegal and raised in Italy, with his parents sending him to a Quranic school near Dakar, the capital of Senegal. He is a practicing Muslim.

name: Maddie Ziegler
about: Maddie Ziegler came to fame as a child performer on the reality show "Dance Moms" and later became known for her collaborations with musician Sia.

name: Erling Haaland
about: As a striker for Manchester City since 2022, Haaland holds several scoring records.  He is the son of Norwegian midfielder Alfie Haaland, who played from 1997-2003.

name: Amanda Gorman
about: Amanda Gorman is an American poet and activist, and the first person to be named National Youth Poet Laureate. She is best known for reciting the poem "The Hill We Climb" at President  's inauguration in 2021.

name: Greta Thunberg
about: Thunberg became heavily involved in climate change activism at age 15, when she gained fame by making speeches outside the Swedish parliament. In 2018 she initiated the school strike for climate movement that spread around the world. An estimated 1.4 million students around the world joined her call.

name: Millie Bobby Brown
about: Brown was one of the breakout stars of the hit Netflix science fiction show " " (2016-present), where she portrays Eleven. For her role in the show she was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award, making her one of the youngest ever nominees, age 13.

name: Robert F. Kennedy
about: Robert F. Kennedy made significant contributions to the civil rights movement and fought against organized crime. He served as the United States Attorney General and later as a U.S. Senator from New York.

name: Edmund Randolph
about: Edmund Randolph was a Founding Father of the United States, serving as delegate from Virginia at the Constitutional Convention. He went on to serve as the first Attorney General after being appointed by  , and then later as Secretary of State also in the Washington administration.

name: Andrew Fisher
about: Scottish born Andrew Fisher was the fifth Australian Prime Minister and the first to lead the Australian Labor Party in a majority government, after winning the 1910 general election.

name: Alfred Deakin
about:
Alfred Deakin was an Australian politician and lawyer, known as the second Prime Minister of Australia. He led the movement for Federation, by which the six British colonies agreed in 1901 to unite as the Commonwealth of Australia. 
 
Deakin served three terms as Prime Minister of Australia: 1903-1904, 1905-1908, and 1909-1910. He played a key role in the formation of Australia throughout this period, laying the foundation for its socio-economic structure.

name: Lionel Martin
about: Lionel Martin co-founded Aston Martin. His passion for cycling and motorsports led him to establish this iconic luxury car brand, best known for its frequent appearances in James Bond films.

name: William George Barker
about: The most decorated serviceman in the history of Canada, and in the history of the British Empire and Commonwealth of Nations.

name: William Lamb
about: William Lamb entered the House of Commons as a Whig MP in 1806 and served 2 terms there until he inherited the title Lord Melbourne and joined the House of Lords.

name: John Abbott
about:
The third Prime Minister of Canada, he served in the office from June 1891 to November 1892.  
 
He considered himself a caretaker prime minister as he only spent 17 months in office.

name: Mikhail Botvinnik
about: Mikhail Botvinnik was a Soviet Russian chess grandmaster and an electrical engineer. He became the sixth World Chess Champion and was a pioneer in computer chess.

name: Hu Jintao
about:
General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China from 2002 to 2012. 
 
His tenure was characterized by collective leadership and consensus-based, technocratic rule.

name: Lyudmila Pavlichenko
about: Pavlichenko is the most successful female sniper in recorded history, with 309 confirmed kills. She served in the Red Army during World War Two, during which time she was nicknamed "Lady Death" for her aptitude with a rifle.

name: Stepan Bandera
about: Stepan Bandera was a Ukrainian political activist and nationalist leader who played a significant role in the struggle for Ukrainian independence during the 20th century. His leadership and actions have been the subject of debate, with some viewing him as a heroic figure fighting for his nation's freedom, while others consider him responsible for atrocities committed during World War II.

name: Leonid Brezhnev
about: Leonid Brezhnev was the dominant political force in Soviet politics through much of the Cold War. He is the 2nd longest serving General Secretary after Stalin himself.

name: Golda Meir
about: Golda Meir was an Israeli politician who served as the fourth Prime Minister of Israel. Born Golda Mabovitch in Kyiv, in what is now Ukraine, she emigrated with her family to the United States in 1906, settling in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Meir's involvement in Zionist politics began in her youth and continued as she moved to Mandatory Palestine in 1921, where she became an active participant in the Zionist movement.

name: Leon Trotsky
about: Leon Trotsky was a Marxist revolutionary, theorist, and Soviet politician who played a crucial role in the Russian Revolution and the early years of the Soviet Union. He was a close associate of   and one of the key architects of the October Revolution, which led to the establishment of a socialist government in Russia.

name: Hu Yaobang
mainType: General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party
about: Hu Yaobang was a Chinese reformist Communist leader and a close ally of party leader  , who helped liberalize China from its strict Marxist past under  .

name: Jiang Zemin
about: Jiang Zemin was a Chinese politician who served as the General Secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) from 1989 to 2002, the Chairman of the Central Military Commission from 1989 to 2004, and the President of the People's Republic of China from 1993 to 2003. His time as leader marked a period of economic reform, political stability, and increasing engagement with the global community.

name: Zhao Ziyang
homePlace: Hua County, Henan, Republic of China
about: Zhao Ziyang was a Chinese politician known for his economic reforms and his involvement in the Tiananmen Square protests. Over his career, he rose to high ranks in the Communist Party of China (CCP), but his controversial positions led to his political downfall and eventual house arrest.

name: Deng Xiaoping
about: Deng Xiaoping was a Chinese revolutionary and politician who was a significant figure in the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). He is recognized for leading China towards a market economy after the Cultural Revolution and for introducing a series of political and economic reforms in the 1980s, a policy famously known as the "Opening Up and Reform."

name: Chiang Kai-shek
about: Chiang Kai-shek played a central role in 20th-century Chinese history. He led the Republic of China during the Second Sino-Japanese War and the Chinese Civil War.

name: Hua Guofeng
about: Chairman of the Communist Party of China from 1976 to 1981 and Premier of the People's Republic of China from 1976 to 1980 Hua Guofeng was  's designated successor.

name: Cixi
about: Empress Dowager Cixi ruled China for nearly 50 years during the late Qing dynasty. She rose from the position of concubine to become the de facto leader of China during a time of significant change and challenges.

name: Mao Zedong
about: One of the most important, controversial and powerful figures in modern history, Mao was the founding father of the People's Republic of China and led the country from its establishment in 1949 until his death in 1976.

name: Paul Morphy
about: Morphy came to be known as the 'Pride and Sorrow of Chess' after he retired from the game at 22, having defeated any and all that might be considered fair competition.

name: José Raúl Capablanca
about: Capablanca was a Cuban chess prodigy and world chess champion (1921-1927). Just before turning 13, in 1901, he beat the reigning Cuban champion Juan Corzo. Then in 1909, he beat Frank Marshall—who was American chess champion from 1909 to 1936—which earned him an invite to the 1911 San Sebastián chess tournament, which he won.

name: Richard Bedford Bennett
about:
Served as the 11th Prime Minister of Canada from August 1930 to October 1935, during the worst of the Great Depression years.  
 
He tried to combat the depression by increasing trade within the British Empire, but his success was limited and his own wealth (often openly displayed) alienated many struggling Canadians.

name: John Diefenbaker
about: The 13th Prime Minister of Canada, serving from June 1957 to April 1963. He led the Tories to their first electoral victory in 27 years. He appointed the first female minister in Canadian history to his Cabinet, as well as the first aboriginal member of the Senate.

name: Charles Tupper
about: Charles Tupper served as the sixth Prime Minister of Canada and was the last surviving Father of Confederation.

name: Louis St. Laurent
about:
Served as the 12th Prime Minister of Canada from November 1948 to June 1957. His foreign policy initiatives transformed Canada from an isolationism with little role in world affairs to an active "middle power."  
 
He was an enthusiastic proponent of Canada's joining NATO in 1949 to fight Communist totalitarianism. He was a strong Canadian nationalist who hated communism and did not fear the United States.

name: Mackenzie Bowell
about: Mackenzie Bowell served as the fifth Prime Minister of Canada. He was known for his long political career and his unusual path to the country's highest office.

name: John Thompson
about: John Thompson was a Canadian lawyer and politician who served as the fourth Prime Minister of Canada, holding office from December 5, 1892, until his untimely death in 1894. Thompson was a lawyer by profession and entered politics in his native province before moving to the federal stage. He was also the first Roman Catholic to hold the office of Canadian Prime Minister.

name: Arthur Meighen
about:
Served two terms as the ninth Prime Minister of Canada: from July 1920 to December 1921, and from June 1926 to September 1926.  
 
He was the first Prime Minister born after Confederation, and is usually considered as one of the weaker Prime Ministers in Canadian history.

name: Robert Borden
about: Served as the eighth Prime Minister of Canada from October 1911 to July 1920. As Prime Minister of Canada during the First World War, he transformed his government to a wartime administration, passing the War Measures Act in 1914, committing Canada to provide half a million soldiers for the war effort. He was soon forced to pass the Military Service Act and the Conscription Crisis of 1917, which divided the country.

name: Alexander Mackenzie
about:
The second Prime Minister of Canada (1873-1878), he introduced the secret ballot, advised the creation of the Supreme Court of Canada, established the Royal Military College of Canada in Kingston in 1874, created the Office of the Auditor General in 1878, and struggled to continue progress on the national railway. 
 
His term was also marked by economic depression that grew out of the Panic of 1873.

name: Lester B. Pearson
about: Lester B. Pearson served as Prime Minister of Canada and won the Nobel Peace Prize. He began his career as a diplomat and became known for his work in international relations.

name: Mackenzie King
about: William Lyon Mackenzie King was Canada's longest-serving Prime Minister. He led the country for over 21 years across three terms, guiding Canada through major events including the Great Depression and World War II.

name: Pierre Trudeau
about:
As head of the Liberal Party, he was Prime Minister of Canada twice, from 1968-1979 and from 1980-1984.  
 
A charismatic leader, he inspired "Trudeaumania" in the late 1960s.

name: Wilfrid Laurier
about: Wilfrid Laurier was the seventh Prime Minister of Canada from 1896 to 1911. He was the first French Canadian to hold this office and is known for his efforts to unite English and French Canadians.

name: John A. Macdonald
about: First Prime Minister of Canada (from 1867-1873 and 1878-1891).

name: Spencer Compton
homePlace: Compton Wynyates, Warwickshire, England, United Kingdom
about:
British Whig statesman who served continuously in government from 1715 until his death.  
 
Compton served as the Prime Minister from 1742 until his death in 1743.  
 
He is considered to have been Britain's second Prime Minister, after  , although he was largely a figurehead, with real power exercised by the Secretary of State, Lord Carteret.

name: Archibald Primrose
about: Archibald Primrose was British Liberal Party Prime Minister for just 15 months (1894-95), only rising to the post after the resignation of  , with whom he'd been politically aligned with since 1879 when he managed Gladstone's first campaign for office.

name: Augustus FitzRoy
about: FitzRoy, the Duke of Grafton, was the youngest ever British Prime Minister when he assumed the office at 33 in 1768. Only   at 24, who later followed him was younger.

name: Frederick North
about: Frederick North, often known as Lord North, was a British politician and central figure in British politics during the tumultuous years of the American Revolution. Serving as Prime Minister of Great Britain from 1770 to 1782, he led Britain during the majority of the American War of Independence. His tenure was marked by significant events, including the imposition of the controversial Intolerable Acts which were a key factor in sparking the revolution.

name: John Russell
about: Scion of one of the most powerful aristocratic families in England, Russell served as British Prime Minister on two occasions during the mid-19th century.

name: William Petty
homePlace: Dublin, County Dublin, Kingdom of Ireland
about: Petty rose to prominence by siding with   and became one of his Secretaries of State Petty, Both Petty and Pitt preferred cooperation over conflict in the American colonies.

name: Henry Campbell-Bannerman
about: Leader of the Liberal Party from 1899 to 1908 and British Prime Minister from 1905 to 1908.

name: Edward Smith-Stanley
about:
Three time British Prime Minister. All his government's lasted less than two years, totaling 3 years 280 days. 
 
His tenure of 22 years as party leader stands as the longest of any political party in British history with only Labour's   coming close at 20 years.

name: Henry Pelham
about: Henry Pelham, regarded as Britain's third Prime Minister succeeded   upon his death in 1743.

name: Robert Jenkinson
about: Robert Jenkinson, Earl of Liverpool became British Prime Minister at 42 after the assassination of   in 1812. He saw the country through a period of unrest at both at home and through the aftermath of the  .

name: James Callaghan
about: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1976 to 1979 and the Leader of the Labour Party from 1976 to 1980.

name: Stanley Baldwin
about: British Conservative who was Prime Minister three times and who dominated British government between the two world wars.

name: George Canning
about: George Canning was a British politician, known particularly for his brief tenure as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom in 1827. Despite his short time in office, he made substantial contributions to the political landscape, with a career spanning several decades in various governmental roles.

name: George Hamilton-Gordon
